[Intro]
[Em7]  [D/F#]
[G]  [Cadd9]
[Em7]  [D/F#]
[G]  [Cadd9]

[Verse 1]
[Em7]Another day [D/F#]another life
[G]Passes by [Cadd9]just like mine-
[Em7]It's not [D/F#]complicated
[G]  [Cadd9]
[Em7]Another mind [D/F#]another soul
[G]Another [Cadd9]body to grow old-
[Em7]It's not [D/F#]complicated
[G]  [Cadd9]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cadd9]Do you ever wonder if the
[D]stars shine out for you?

[Chorus]
[G]Float [D/F#]down
[Em7]Like [Cadd9]autumn lea-
[G]ves Hush [D/F#]now
[Em7]Close your eyes [Cadd9]before the sleep
[G]And you're [D/F#]miles away
[Em7]And [Cadd9]yesterday
[G][D/F#]you were here-
[Em7]with [Cadd9]me

[Bridge]
[Em7]  [D/F#]
[G]  [Cadd9]
[Em7]  [D/F#]
[G]  [Cadd9]

[Verse 2]
[Em7]Another tear [D/F#]another cry
[G]Another place [Cadd9]for us to die
[Em7]It's not [D/F#]complicated
[G]  [Cadd9]
[Em7]Another love [D/F#]that's gone to waste
[G]Another light [Cadd9]lost from your face-
[Em7]It's [D/F#]complicated
[G]  [Cadd9]

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cadd9]Do you ever wonder if the
[D]stars shine out for you?

[Chorus]
[G]Float [D/F#]down
[Em7]Like [Cadd9]autumn lea-
[G]ves Hush [D/F#]now
[Em7]Close your eyes [Cadd9]before the sleep
[G]And you're [D/F#]miles away
[Em7]And [Cadd9]yesterday
[G][D/F#]you were here-
[Em7]with [Cadd9]me

[Bridge]
[Em7]How I miss
[Cadd9]you My sym-
[G]phony played the song
[D/F#]that carried you out
[Em7]How I miss
[Cadd9]you And I,
[G]I miss you and I
[D/F#]wish you'd stay-

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cadd9]Do you ever wonder if the
[D]stars shine out for you?

[Chorus]
[G]Float [D/F#]down
[Em7]Like [Cadd9]autumn lea-
[G]ves Hush [D/F#]now
[Em7]Close your eyes [Cadd9]before the sleep
[G]And you're [D/F#]miles away
[Em7]And [Cadd9]yesterday
[G][D/F#]you were here-
[Em7]with [Cadd9]me

[Outro]
[Em7]  [D/F#]
[G]  [Cadd9]
[Em7]  [D/F#]
[G]  [Cadd9]
[G]Touch [D/F#]down
[Em7]Like a [Cadd9]seven four seven
[G]Or stay [D/F#]out
[Em7]and we'll [A#m7]live forever now
title: Autumn Leaves
tuning: E A D G B E
